overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation performance, and establishing a compact tick-based event log for endgame analysis.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a 64-bit FNV-1a hash function for core simulation state. Use constexpr where possible. Store state in a fixed-size array of uint64_t. No dynamic allocation. Hash is computed incrementally per tick. Provide a static method to verify hash against stored value. Ensure endianness consistency.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hash value is identical across multiple runs with same seed. Verification fails on any state mutation. No heap allocations during hash computation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures reliable save/load functionality and deterministic replay.

tasks.title: Zero-Allocation Colonist Psychology State Machine
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a fixed-size enum for psychological states (Idle, Working, Resting, Panicked). Use a struct with uint8_t for state and float for stress level. Implement transition logic using switch-case. No std::string or std::vector. State changes are recorded in a circular buffer of size 1024.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: State transitions are correct and fast. Memory footprint is minimal. Circular buffer wraps correctly.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks and more responsive colonist behavior.

tasks.title: Compact Tick-Based Event Log for Endgame Analysis
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a struct Event with uint32_t tick, uint16_t type, and uint16_t data. Store events in a static array of size 4096. Implement push and pop operations. Provide a method to retrieve events within a tick range. No dynamic memory.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Events are stored and retrieved correctly. Memory usage is fixed. No fragmentation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Enables detailed analysis of simulation history for debugging and replay.
